text:
In Sanskrit:
Salutations!
All the victors of the past, present, and future,
Their mother is you, the virtuous one.
You are the goddess, the Victorious One's child,
Possessing the nature of non-nature.
The mother of the buddhas, her name
I, the virtuous one, shall proclaim.
Listen, those who wish for prosperity!
The perfection of wisdom,
Omniscience,
The knowledge of all aspects of the path,
